text: Australia drives on the **left**.
NOTE: A handful of other countries also drive on the left. See [this](/images/australia/rightleftdrive.png) infographic for more information.
text_zh: 澳洲是**靠左**行駛的。
注意：少數其他國家也是靠左行駛。更多資訊請參閱[這張](/images/australia/rightleftdrive.png)資訊圖表。

text: Conversely, the Altiplano looks more **arid** in the more southern half: around Oruro, and the roads going southwest towards Chile.
NOTE: There is one major exception to this: one driving side of the divided part of Ruta 1 looks somewhat green all the way up to Oruro (due to this coverage being captured in a different season).
text_zh: 相反地，阿爾蒂普拉諾高原在南半部看起來更加**乾旱**：例如奧魯羅（Oruro）周圍，以及向西南延伸通往智利的道路。
註：這裡有一個主要的例外：Ruta 1 分隔島路段的其中一個車道方向一路延伸到奧魯羅看起來都有些綠意（因為這段街景覆蓋是在不同季節拍攝的）。

text: Like the other countries in Southern Africa, outside road lines (if present) are **yellow**, while centre road lines are **white**.
NOTE: Outside yellow road lines in arid environments also exist in Israel, Palestine, Jordan, and the UAE. However, these countries all drive on the right side.
text_zh: 與非洲南部的其他國家一樣，外側道路標線（若有）為**黃色**，而中央道路標線為**白色**。
註：乾旱環境中的外側黃色道路標線也存在於以色列、巴勒斯坦、約旦和阿拉伯聯合大公國。然而，這些國家都是靠右行駛。

text: Cambodia drives on the **right**.
NOTE: Thailand drives on the left, while Vietnam and Laos also drive on the right.
text_zh: 柬埔寨靠**右**行駛。
注意：泰國靠左行駛，而越南與寮國也是靠右行駛。

text: Cyprus drives on the **left** side of the road.
NOTE: Malta also drives on the left.
text_zh: 賽普勒斯是靠道路**左側**行駛。
注意：馬爾他也是靠左駕駛。

text: Hong Kong drives on the **left**.
NOTE: Singapore also drives on the left, however Taiwan drives on the right.
text_zh: 香港為**靠左**駕駛。
注意：新加坡也是靠左駕駛，不過台灣是靠右駕駛。

text: Indonesia drives on the **left**.
NOTE: Malaysia drives on the left, while the Philippines drives on the right.
text_zh: 印尼靠**左**側行駛。
注意：馬來西亞靠左側行駛，菲律賓則靠右側行駛。

text: Ireland and the UK **drive on the left side** of the road.
NOTE: The only other European countries to drive on the left are Malta and Cyprus, but landscape should be sufficient to tell them apart.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭和英國都是**靠左側駕駛**。
注意：歐洲其他靠左側駕駛的國家只有馬爾他和賽普勒斯，但景觀應該足以將它們區分開來。

text: Japan drives on the **left** **hand **side of the road.
NOTE: Hong Kong drives on the left hand side of the road, same as Japan. South Korea and Taiwan drive on the right hand side instead.
text_zh: 日本**靠左**行駛。
註：香港與日本同樣靠左行駛；南韓與台灣則是靠右。

text: Laos drives on the **right hand** side of the road.
NOTE: This is mostly useful to distinguish between Thailand, which drives on the left hand side of the road.
text_zh: 寮國行駛在道路的**右側**。
註記：這主要有助於與行駛在道路左側的泰國進行區分。

text: As previously mentioned, the Vientiane area is the only part of Laos where the Google car is **not **visible. It also has a considerable amount of rural coverage, especially to its southeast.
NOTE: This may lead to toss-ups with Thailand and Cambodia. Use the driving side (Thailand being left, and Laos and Cambodia right), along with other clues to tell them apart.
text_zh: 如前所述，永珍地區是寮國唯一**看不到** Google 車的地區。它也有相當多的鄉村街景覆蓋，特別是在其東南部。
註記：這可能會導致與泰國和柬埔寨難分難解。請使用行駛方向（泰國為左側，寮國和柬埔寨為右側）以及其他線索來區分牠們。

text: Malta drives on the **left**.
NOTE: Cyprus also drives on the left.
text_zh: 馬爾他是**靠左**駕駛。
注意：賽普勒斯也是靠左駕駛。

text: Namibia drives on the **left side** of the road.
NOTE: This is also true for other countries in southern and eastern Africa. However all Middle Eastern countries with coverage drive on the right side.
text_zh: 納米比亞是 **靠左側** 行駛。
注意：非洲南部和東部的其他國家也是如此。然而，所有有街景覆蓋的中東國家都是靠右行駛。

text: The Philippines drives on the **right**.
NOTE: Within Southeast Asia, Cambodia, Laos, Taiwan and Vietnam also drive on the right.
text_zh: 菲律賓靠 **右** 行駛。
注意：在東南亞中，柬埔寨、寮國、台灣和越南也是靠右行駛。

text: Senegal drives on the **right**.
NOTE: This is mostly useful to distinguish it from Kenya, which drives on the left. The other countries with coverage in Africa that drive on the right are Ghana, Nigeria, Rwanda and Tunisia.
text_zh: 塞內加爾是**靠右**行駛。
注意：這主要是用來與靠左行駛的肯亞做區分。非洲其他有街景覆蓋且靠右行駛的國家有迦納、奈及利亞、盧安達和突尼西亞。

text: South Africa drives on the **left.**
NOTE: A handful of other countries also drive on the left. See [this](/images/south-africa/rightleftdrive.png) infographic for more information.
text_zh: 南非靠**左**側駕駛。
註：少數其他國家也靠左駕駛。欲了解更多資訊，請參見[此](/images/south-africa/rightleftdrive.png)資訊圖表。

text: Taiwan drives on the **right** side of the road.
NOTE: Japan and Hong Kong drive on the left.
text_zh: 台灣**靠右**行駛。
註：日本與香港是靠左行駛。

text: Thailand drives on the **left hand** side of the road.
NOTE: Cambodia, Vietnam and Laos drive on the right hand side.
text_zh: 泰國車輛行駛在道路的**左側**。
註：柬埔寨、越南和寮國則是行駛在右側。

text: **Thai script** is compact and in many fonts has tiny circles within most letters.

NOTE: The Cambodian (Khmer) script often has longer lines and more accents underneath the lettering, as opposed to the Thai script. The Lao script looks similar to the Thai script. Make sure to check the driving side before guessing.
text_zh: **泰文**結構緊湊，在許多字體中，多數字母內部都有小圓圈。
註：與泰文相比，柬埔寨文（高棉文）通常有更長的線條，且字母下方有更多裝飾符號。寮文看起來與泰文相似。猜測前請務必檢查行駛車道。

text: Uganda drives on the **left hand** side of the road.
NOTE: African countries are split between right and left hand drive. For a full overview of countries and their driving side, see [here](/images/uganda/rightleftdrive.png).
text_zh: 烏干達靠 **左側** 行駛。
註：非洲國家的行駛方向分為靠右與靠左。如需國家及其行駛方向的完整總覽，請參見[此處](/images/uganda/rightleftdrive.png)。

text: The UK drives on the **left side** of the road.
NOTE: The UK, Ireland, Malta and Cyprus are the only European countries that drive on the left.
text_zh: 英國是靠**左側**駕駛。
注意：英國、愛爾蘭、馬爾他和賽普勒斯是僅有的靠左駕駛的歐洲國家。

text: The **United States Virgin Islands** is a Caribbean US territory and the only area of the US that drives on the left side of the road.
A separate Plonk It guide to the United States Virgin Islands can be found [here](https://www.plonkit.net/us-virgin-islands).
text_zh: **美屬維京群島**是加勒比海的美國領地，也是美國唯一靠道路左側駕駛的地區。
可以在[這裡](https://www.plonkit.net/us-virgin-islands)找到獨立的 Plonk It 美屬維京群島指南。

text: Vietnam drives on the **right side** of the road.
NOTE: Cambodia and the Philippines are the only other southeast Asian countries with normal Street View that drives on the right side.
text_zh: 越南是**靠右側**行車。
注意：柬埔寨和菲律賓是僅有的其他靠右行車且擁有正常街景的東南亞國家。
